name: fdic-banks-mcp-server
description: Search FDIC-insured banks, Call Report financials, peer rankings, failures, deposit market share.

FDIC_RATE_LIMIT_RPS.title: FDIC request rate (per second)
FDIC_RATE_LIMIT_RPS.description: Maximum request starts per second to api.fdic.gov (1–15).

FDIC_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS.title: Response cache TTL (seconds)
FDIC_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS.description: TTL of the in-process FDIC response cache; 0 disables caching.

FDIC_PANEL_MAX_ROWS.title: Financial panel row cap
FDIC_PANEL_MAX_ROWS.description: Row cap for one fdic_query_financials panel (1,000–200,000). Newest quarters are kept when it binds.

FDIC_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.title: Enable fdic_dataframe_drop
FDIC_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.description: Expose the tool that drops a staged dataframe before its TTL.
